# Stack Overflow developer knowledge sharing

A developer question-and-answer platform for discovering, publishing, answering, commenting on, voting on, and managing questions and profiles.

The application, server and evaluator use the fixed UTC time 2026-07-21T12:02:00Z. The expired-comment scenario independently uses fixed UTC time 2026-07-21T12:06:00Z.

For public historical question index: Historical metrics, comment clock, collapsed thread and sort samples cannot be reproduced by a single new UI post. Missing timestamps use 2026-07-15T12:00:00Z. Answered sample questions contain an answer by Helpful User. Only dedicated voting/editing records are mutable; other samples remain public after deletion of any UI-created question.

For accounts, questions, answers, comments and filters: All ordinary mutable source examples are created through UI within each case. Question titles append the automatically generated worker-run identifier, parallelIndex and case slug; registration email is new_stack_user+<suffix>@example.com. Helpers create a question as the named owner, then answers/comments as the named author in separate authenticated browser contexts. Each case owns its objects.

For session, edit draft, search, voting and preferences: Produced only by public interactions. No storage injection or hidden API. Vote effects are relative to the author current public reputation, which may include other independent case contributions.

## REQ-1 Discover the community

Anonymous and authenticated visitors discover populated public questions. Header, left navigation, main feed and right widgets follow the homepage reference. Right widgets expose The Overflow Blog, meta items, Hot Network Questions and custom filter/tag watchlists.

Global header is a banner and main navigation is named Main navigation. Question feed contains summary regions named Question <title>. Navigational actions may be links or buttons; status metrics expose plain numeric text.

### REQ-3.1 Open public Questions listing

Follow Questions in Main navigation. Question feed exposes Ask Question and published question summaries.

This requirement establishes the page entry and visible reference state before sibling behaviors. It does not implement their validation or state transitions. Every case establishes its own preconditions through the existing UI; tests do not depend on previous cases.

Preserved presentation and source context:
Questions carry title, rendered body, tags, engagement metadata and author attribution. Owner deletion hides the post from public lists; database preservation is outside the observable oracle.

    A developer question-and-answer platform for discovering, publishing, answering, commenting on, voting on, and managing questions and profiles.

    The application, server and evaluator use the fixed UTC time 2026-07-21T12:02:00Z. The expired-comment scenario independently uses fixed UTC time 2026-07-21T12:06:00Z.

    For public historical question index: Historical metrics, comment clock, collapsed thread and sort samples cannot be reproduced by a single new UI post. Missing timestamps use 2026-07-15T12:00:00Z. Answered sample questions contain an answer by Helpful User. Only dedicated voting/editing records are mutable; other samples remain public after deletion of any UI-created question.

    For accounts, questions, answers, comments and filters: All ordinary mutable source examples are created through UI within each case. Question titles append the automatically generated worker-run identifier, parallelIndex and case slug; registration email is new_stack_user+<suffix>@example.com. Helpers create a question as the named owner, then answers/comments as the named author in separate authenticated browser contexts. Each case owns its objects.

    For session, edit draft, search, voting and preferences: Produced only by public interactions. No storage injection or hidden API. Vote effects are relative to the author current public reputation, which may include other independent case contributions.
